brief: Prioritise Sandbourne Bend (SUB-SGW-493) for pre-event attention ahead of the forecast heat event, as an ageing unit with a history of high loading has a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). Review open work orders for the asset against its ability to shed heat in accordance with SOP-016. Where the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
